title: spec(ui): record:details `hideEmpty: false` — in read-only mode an all-empty section renders its heading plus one fold row; describe() says so
body:
Fixes #25511

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic

## What this changes

The `record:details` section key `hideEmpty` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`, the `RecordDetailsProps.sections[]` object form) gets a new `describe()` text. It implements ruling C on objectstack-ai/objectui#13386 (batch #7 item 4, the maintainer's 「objectui 三个都同意」, 2026-10-23T16:08:53Z):

- **Default (key omitted, or `true`): unchanged.** An all-empty section renders nothing at all: no heading, no skeleton.
- **`false`, read-only mode:** an all-empty section renders its heading plus one fold row that counts the empty fields and reveals them on request. This is the same fold a partly-filled section uses.
- **`false`, edit mode:** unchanged. Every field renders as an editable row.

No key, shape or default changes. The renderer change is objectui's (`DetailSection`); objectstack-ai/objectui#13386 carries `Blocked-by:` this card and remains open.

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `describe()` | Hide this section's empty fields (renderer default: on — and a section whose fields are ALL empty then renders nothing at all: no heading, no skeleton). Set `false` to render empty rows, keeping the section's label skeleton on an all-empty record (e.g. a brand-new one). | Whether this section disappears when ALL its fields are empty (renderer default: on — it then renders nothing at all: no heading, no skeleton). Set `false` to keep it on an all-empty record (e.g. a brand-new one): in read-only mode it renders its heading plus one fold row that counts the empty fields and reveals them on request — the same fold a partly-filled section uses; in edit mode it renders every field as an editable row. |

Files:

- `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`: the describe string, plus one docblock paragraph above it recording the re-ruled `false` rendering and that the key governs only the all-empty case. The docblock's existing text is about the default and the pre-declaration history, so it stays as it was.
- `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`: regenerated with `gen:docs`. `check:generated` named it as the only stale artifact. The shipped `json-schema/ui/RecordDetailsProps.json` (gitignored, in `files[]`) carries the new text after a build.
- `.changeset/25511-hide-empty-describe.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor`, with both declaration lines.

Landing: the measured producer is the one the card named, `component.zod.ts` at `:1440`. No other producer of this text exists (`git grep` for the old phrases finds only the generated mdx, a test comment and the release-owned `CHANGELOG.md`).

## Two wording calls

1. **The fold label is not quoted.** The card writes the row as "N empty fields · Show". The ruling's text is 「N 个空字段 · 展开」, and what it rules is "the same fold the mixed sections use". objectui's English label for that fold is "Show {{count}} empty fields" (`detail.showEmptyFields`, `packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` at objectui `7981384`). Quoting "N empty fields · Show" would contradict "the same fold", and quoting objectui's string would pin a label the spec does not own. So the text says what the row does: it counts the empty fields and reveals them on request.
2. **The lead changed from "Hide this section's empty fields" to "Whether this section disappears when ALL its fields are empty".** Under C, both values hide an all-empty section's empty rows in read-only mode (`true` drops the section, `false` folds the rows), so the old lead no longer told the two values apart. The key never governed a partly-filled section's empty rows either: the renderer's own fold handles those whatever the key says (objectui#7129 Q2-C). The default sentence keeps its meaning; only its grammar follows the new lead.

## Acceptance notes

- **The renderer lags the text until objectstack-ai/objectui#13386 lands.** Until then, a `false` all-empty section still renders empty rows in read-only mode. The ruling orders it this way (spec text first, renderer second).
- **The default in edit mode** (noted, not filed; carrier: none). objectui renders every row of an all-empty section in edit mode for the default too (`hideAllEmptySection` requires `!isEditing`, `DetailSection.tsx` at objectui `7981384`). The default sentence says "renders nothing at all" with no mode qualifier, as the card asked. No author writes wrong metadata because of it.
- **A stale test comment** (noted, not filed; carrier: none). `packages/spec/src/ui/component.test.ts` at about line 636 still calls `false` "the only spelling that keeps a section's label skeleton on an all-empty record". That file is outside the claim's file surface, and no assertion depends on the wording.
